title: The Mystery-Solving Water Taxi
subtitle_source: subs_resolved/0956.txt, subs_resolved/0957.txt (674 dialogue lines, full transcript read)
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Kogoro Mori, Conan, Inspector Megure, Takagi, Chiba) omitted by convention. case_type: double_murder -- two separate killings by two separate culprits within the same two-part episode. Primary label targets Takase Rintaro (p4), whose murder of Eiji is the whodunit the title's water-taxi confrontation directly resolves; Yuichi's killing of Yasuko is fully modeled (kills/burns edges, motive) but intentionally left out of `label.murderer_id` since it is a secondary twist that unravels Takase's stated motive rather than the case the detectives are formally assigned to solve. CORRECTIONS vs. the old low-fidelity file (cases/ep956-957_the_mystery-solving_water_taxi.json): (1) the old file completely omitted Yasuko's murder and the house fire -- a second, plot-critical crime committed by Yuichi (Eiji's older brother), who confesses by phone at the end to killing their mother and burning the house to destroy evidence; (2) the old file's stated motive for Takase ('learning her son [Eiji] abuses her') repeats the rumor everyone in the episode believes at the time but which the transcript reveals is backwards: it was actually Yuichi who was abusing Yasuko, and Eiji who had been restraining him -- Takase's real motive is a mistaken-identity revenge/gratitude killing based on that false rumor, and this reversal (established via the hospital-visit timeline clue) is the mechanism Kogoro uses to break Takase's alibi belief and simultaneously expose Yuichi. The old file's culprit call for Eiji's murder (Takase) itself holds up.
